class.name: GameState
class.brief_description: What everyone is allowed to know about the match, including the player list.
class.description: The counterpart to [GameMode]. The game mode owns the [i]rules[/i] and is conceptually server-only; the game state owns the [i]facts[/i] and has to exist on clients too. That is why [GFGDSceneTree] creates it rather than the game mode, and why [PlayerState] hangs off it. Lives at [code]/root/GameState[/code], is recreated with each level, and is added to the tree [i]before[/i] the game mode runs [code]_init_game[/code] - so [method GameMode.login] already has somewhere to attach player states. Override [code]_init_game_state[/code] to set up match state. Provide your own subclass through [member GameModeSettings.game_state_scene].

method.name: add_player_state
method.description: Reparents the [PlayerState] under this node and adds it to [method get_player_array].
